Who We Are

Rooted in Community. Driven by Equity.

American Partners Community Development Foundation (APCDF) is a 501(c)(3) nonprofit that acquires foreclosed properties and transforms them into HUD-eligible affordable homes — breathing new life into vacant housing while serving families in need. We partner with local organizations, community leaders, credit unions, and municipal partners to create lasting, equitable change. Our long-term vision includes building new affordable housing in the communities we serve, in partnership with developers and government agencies committed to the same goal.

Partner With Us

🤝 Community-Led

We follow the lead of the communities we serve. Residents shape our priorities and guide how resources are deployed.

📊 Accountable & Transparent

Our financials are publicly available. We pursue rigorous evaluation of every program to maximize impact per dollar.

🌱 Long-Term Investment

We focus on systemic change — not one-time fixes. We measure success over years, not news cycles.

🔗 Partnership Model

APCDF works alongside existing community organizations, amplifying their work rather than duplicating it.

What We Do

Our Programs

APCDF currently operates two active programs — affordable housing acquisition and a community holiday giving initiative — while pursuing grant funding to expand our reach across economic opportunity, education, and community resilience.

🏘️

Affordable Housing Initiative Active

APCDF acquires foreclosed properties and converts them into HUD-eligible rental homes, returning vacant houses to productive use while expanding the stock of quality affordable housing. We currently own and operate two HUD-compliant rental properties — in Roanoke, VA and Eden, NC. Looking ahead, APCDF is working to partner with developers, municipalities, and community organizations to build new affordable housing in the cities and regions we serve.

Learn More →
🎄

Chari-Tree Holiday Giving Drive Active

In partnership with American Partners Federal Credit Union, APCDF serves as the fiscal sponsor of the annual Chari-Tree Event — a holiday fundraising tradition supporting local charities and nonprofits throughout Franklin County and Roanoke, VA. Local organizations decorate Christmas trees displayed at the APFCU Rocky Mount branch, and community members vote for their favorites by making monetary donations. All contributions are made to APCDF for tax-deductibility, then disbursed 100% to each participating nonprofit. Businesses may also contribute raffle prizes or sponsor a tree to benefit designated charities.

Become a Member

Join the Foundation. Invest in Your Community.

APCDF is a membership-based nonprofit association. Individuals and businesses join by making a membership contribution — your dues directly fund affordable housing acquisition, community development programs, and the long-term mission of APCDF.

Membership Tiers

Individual
$10
Community Member — Annual membership for individuals. Includes voting rights at Annual Member Meetings, quarterly impact newsletter, and priority enrollment in APCDF programs. Members who open an account at American Partners Federal Credit Union may qualify for CU membership through APCDF's SEG designation.
Supporter
$50
Supporting Member — All Individual Member benefits, plus recognition in APCDF's annual report and invitation to exclusive member briefings on program development and housing initiatives.
Champion
$250
Champion Member — All Supporting Member benefits, plus named recognition on the APCDF website and a direct impact report showing how your contribution was deployed.
Business
$500+
Corporate Member — For businesses and organizations committed to community development. Includes co-branded partnership recognition, employee volunteer opportunities, and CRA documentation support for eligible institutions.

Additional Ways to Support

Planned giving & bequests Stock & asset donations Grant funding & foundation gifts Donate in honor / in memory

Select Membership Type

All memberships are annual and tax-deductible.

🏦 Credit Union Connection
APCDF is pursuing SEG (Select Employee Group) designation with American Partners Federal Credit Union. Once approved, APCDF members who open an APFCU account may qualify for credit union membership through the Foundation's SEG status — expanding access to affordable financial services for our community.
